text: Do it tired. Do it scared. Just do it today.
Show up on the dull days; that is where the habit gets its spine.
Discipline is smaller than you think: one sock, one page, one call.
Make the bed before your doubts wake up. Small promises keep their word.
Motivation is a guest. Discipline pays the rent every single month.
Your habits are always watching. Make them proud when nobody else is looking.
The work does not care how you feel. Sit down and start anyway.
